decisions.reason: As a newly launched extension of the firm’s established automation portfolio in a growing industry, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot should be kept because its fit with core capabilities and likely long sales cycle mean performance is still too uncertain to justify withdrawal.

The automatic de-shuttering robot should be kept because it builds on existing plant automation competences, faces no clear evidence of underperformance, and the firm’s R&D strength and broad product range provide enough slack to continue learning from the market.

The profile storage robot should be kept because it complements integrated precast production solutions, and in a research-active German machinery firm such adjacent products would usually be given more time before being judged below aspiration levels.

The automatic shuttering robot should be kept because it is closely related to the firm’s established offer and, given favorable industry conditions and boundedly rational evaluation under uncertainty, management would normally continue it rather than reallocate resources immediately.
